messages:
Ari (Partnerships): Quick sync  we need a concise smoke plan to validate LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters against GatewayX and FlowBridge before marketplace listing. Deliverables: manifest lint, 60s demo clip, and a 1-page runbook. Who can take manifest validator?
Noor (Eng-Platform): I'll own the manifest validator + staging namespaces. Will add fields: tokenizer_version, quant_tests, hardware_compat.
Samir (DevEx): I'll draft the smoke tests: tokenization parity check, embedding-dim test, and streaming-start latency. Small script: `curl -s -N -X POST https://staging.gatewayx/redwood/v1/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"adapter":"langchain","prompt":"x"}' | head -n1` Expect chunk within 300ms.
Clara (Marketing): For marketplace we need tagline (<=80 chars), logo svg, short integration blurb, and approved quote. Deadline for marketing assets?
Ari (Partnerships): Ask partners for assets + manifest by 2026-05-17. Internal dry-run 2026-05-24. Public listing after partner legal ok.
Noor (Eng-Platform): InfraBot: creating namespace isv-2465-01 (ttl 72h).
InfraBot: [system] namespace isv-2465-01 created.
Samir (DevEx): Also adding a tiny GH repo with tests and a sample adapter shim. Will tag runs with adapter+hw combo for perf comparisons.
Clara (Marketing): I'll prepare the listing template and a 60s script for the demo. Partners: we need a short approved quote or we default to a neutral line.
Ari (Partnerships): Action items: Noor validator + namespaces, Samir tests + repo, Clara listing copy, partners: manifest + assets. Check-in Tue 09:30 PT. :calendar:
